channel.title: Godwin Ubani's Blog
channel.description: Notes from Godwin Ubani on being a Fractional CTO, building AI products, cross-border trade infrastructure, and cybersecurity for Gen Z builders.

item.title: Why I Chose to Be a Fractional CTO Instead of Chasing a Full-Time Title
item.description: On trading one big title for several real problems — and why the fractional model fits how early-stage technical work actually gets done.

item.title: What Building Korvanta Taught Me About Cross-Border Trade Infrastructure
item.description: Payments between Africa and China look simple from the outside. Here's what actually makes the problem hard, and why we started with Nigeria.

item.title: 5 Cybersecurity Habits Every Gen Z Builder Needs
item.description: The habits I kept coming back to while writing Shield Up — none of them require being technical, all of them require being consistent.
